spec: §2 + §14 — project keyset vectors: mnemonic -> NodeId (Ed25519 pubkey, B2) + X25519 pubkey
description: Full keyset derivation known answers: BIP-39 words -> seed -> SLIP-0010 m/111'/0'/{0',1'} -> Ed25519 pubkey (this IS the NodeId, B2: raw 32 bytes, no hashing) and X25519 pubkey (RFC 7748 basepoint multiplication of the clamped scalar). public_keyset is the 64B wire/disk form (sign_pubkey || enc_pubkey); private_keyset is the 64B (signing seed || raw X25519 scalar) form. These mnemonics are PUBLIC well-known test phrases — never use them for a real node.
